51655-the-historical-jesus-a-survey-of-p.description: A book by John M. Robertson. Collapse of the thesis of "human characteristics." The myth  and the historicity of Herakles. The more considerate thesis  of Schmiedel: argument from "derogatory" episodes. Kalthoff on  the human characteristics in Ruth and Jonah. Confusion of the new  argument. Jesus introduced in Mark with divine characteristics. The  Unitarian blunder as to "conventional" and "unconventional"  hero-worship. Jewish and Pagan heroes and Gods alike put in  "derogatory" positions.

arxiv-2009-01752.title: Dual-probe 1D hybrid fs/ps rotational CARS for simultaneous single-shot temperature, pressure, and O 2 /N 2 measurements Journal: ol
arxiv-2009-01752.creator: David Escofet-Martin, Anthony O. Ojo, Joshua Collins, Nils Torge Mecker, Mark Linne, Brian Peterson
arxiv-2009-01752.description: Abstract We employ dual-probe one-dimensional (1D) femtosecond (fs)/picosecond (ps) hybrid rotational coherent anti-Stokes Raman spectroscopy (HRCARS) to investigate simultaneous temperature, pressure, and O 2 /N 2 measurements for gas-phase diagnostics. The dual-probe HRCARS technique allows for simultaneous measurements from the time and frequency-domain. A novel approach for measuring pressure, which offers high accuracy (<1%) and precision (0.42%), is presented.

arxiv-2210-03000.title: On isometric immersions of almost k k -product manifolds
arxiv-2210-03000.creator: Vladimir Rovenski, Paweł Walczak
arxiv-2210-03000.description: Abstract A Riemannian manifold endowed with k ≥ 2 k\geq 2 complementary pairwise orthogonal distributions is called a Riemannian almost k k -product manifold. In the article, we study the following problem: find a relationship between intrinsic and extrinsic invariants of a Riemannian almost k k -product manifold isometrically immersed in another Riemannian manifold.

arxiv-2211-13035.title: Can lies be faked? Comparing low-stakes and high-stakes deception video datasets from a Machine Learning perspective
arxiv-2211-13035.creator: Mateus Karvat Camara, Adriana Postal, Tomas Henrique Maul, Gustavo Paetzold
arxiv-2211-13035.description: Abstract Despite the great impact of lies in human societies and a meager 54% human accuracy for Deception Detection (DD), Machine Learning systems that perform automated DD are still not viable for proper application in real-life settings due to data scarcity.

arxiv-2503-16737.title: Revenue Maximization Under Sequential Price Competition Via The Estimation Of s s -Concave Demand Functions
arxiv-2503-16737.creator: Daniele Bracale, Moulinath Banerjee & Yuekai Sun, Cong Shi
arxiv-2503-16737.description: Abstract We consider price competition among multiple sellers over a selling horizon of T T periods. In each period, sellers simultaneously offer their prices (which are made public) and subsequently observe their respective demand (not made public). The demand function of each seller depends on all sellers’ prices through a private, unknown, and nonlinear relationship.

arxiv-2505-20886.title: Slowly Rotating and Tidal Deformation of Nonlocal Modified Tolman VII Star
arxiv-2505-20886.creator: Byon N. Jayawiguna, Piyabut Burikham
arxiv-2505-20886.description: Abstract We investigate the moment of inertia, quadrupole deformation, and tidal deformation within the framework of nonlocal gravity, utilizing the exact modified Tolman-VII (NEMTVII) density model with an isotropic perfect fluid. The Love number ( k 2 ) (k_{2}) is derived using standard even-parity perturbation theory.

arxiv-2509-22888.title: A Geometric Lens on LLM Abilities through Joint Embedding Item Response Theory
arxiv-2509-22888.creator: Louie Hong Yao, Nicholas Jarvis, Tiffany Zhan, Saptarshi Ghosh, Linfeng Liu, Tianyu Jiang
arxiv-2509-22888.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Louie Hong Yao, Nicholas Jarvis, Tiffany Zhan, Saptarshi Ghosh, Linfeng Liu, Tianyu Jiang. Standard LLM evaluation practices compress diverse abilities into single scores, obscuring their inherently multidimensional nature. We present JE-IRT , a geometric item-response framework that embeds both LLMs and questions in a shared space. For question embeddings, the direction encodes semantics and the norm encodes difficulty, while correctness on each question is determined by the geometric interaction between the model and question embeddings.

pmc-11344080.title: Prefrontal cortex molecular clock modulates development of depression-like phenotype and rapid antidepressant response in mice
pmc-11344080.creator: David H. Sarrazin, Wilf Gardner, Carole Marchese, Martin Balzinger, Chockalingam Ramanathan, Marion Schott, Stanislav Rozov, Maxime Veleanu, Stefan Vestring, Claus Normann, Tomi Rantamäki, Benedicte Antoine, Michel Barrot, Etienne Challet, Patrice Bourgin, Tsvetan Serchov
pmc-11344080.description: Depression is associated with dysregulated circadian rhythms, but the role of intrinsic clocks in mood-controlling brain regions remains poorly understood. We found increased circadian negative loop and decreased positive clock regulators expression in the medial prefrontal cortex (mPFC) of a mouse model of depression, and a subsequent clock countermodulation by the rapid antidepressant ketamine.

pmc-11477498.title: Turn-On Fluorescence Probe for Cancer-Related γ-Glutamyltranspeptidase Detection
pmc-11477498.creator: Muhammad Saleem, Muhammad Hanif, Samuel Bonne, Muhammad Zeeshan, Salahuddin Khan, Muhammad Rafiq, Tehreem Tahir, Changrui Lu, Rujie Cai
pmc-11477498.description: The design and development of fluorescent materials for detecting cancer-related enzymes are crucial for cancer diagnosis and treatment. Herein, we present a substituted rhodamine derivative for the chromogenic and fluorogenic detection of the cancer-relevant enzyme γ-glutamyltranspeptidase (GGT). Initially, the probe is non-chromic and non-emissive due to its spirolactam form, which hinders extensive electronic delocalization over broader pathway.

pmc-12430658.title: Enhancing Biological Nitrogen Fixation Through Diverse Pasture Swards
pmc-12430658.creator: Rukshagini Sutharsan, Paramsothy Jeyakumar, Lucy Burkitt, Dumsane Themba Matse, Ramadoss Dhanuskodi, James Hanly, Daniel J Donaghy, Hongmei Cai
pmc-12430658.description: Regenerative agricultural practices emphasize the use of diverse pasture species within sustainable agriculture production systems. The inclusion of a range of legume species in diverse pasture swards is likely to increase biological N fixation (BNF) across seasons, reducing the system’s reliance on synthetic N inputs.

pmc-12444943.description: PM2.5 is a critical air pollutant that significantly impacts human health and the environment. To develop effective air quality management and mitigation strategies, understanding PM2.5 source attribution and associated health risks is essential. This study investigates the source attribution and health burden of PM2.

pmc-12506348.title: Morphology, transcriptome and physiology analyses reveal adaptation mechanisms of Gymnocypris Przewalskii juveniles to saline-alkaline stresses
pmc-12506348.creator: Zihan Gao, Le Wang, Yanrong Cui, Yixin Li, Luyang Yan, Yike Deng, Wengen Tian, Fulei Wei, Jian Liang
pmc-12506348.description: BackgroundNaked carp (Gymnocypris przewalskii), a fish endemic to Qinghai Lake, China, has attracted extensive attention for its adaptation to salinity and alkalinity stress. However, the survival mechanism of G. przewalskii against saline-alkaline water environments remains elusive. In this study, we aimed to reveal the causes of saline-alkaline tolerance of G. przewalskii through the analysis of morphological, physiological and transcriptomic dimensions.

pmc-13117710.title: Engineering a Nanostructured Hybrid Gel System with Sodium Humate for Enhanced Wound Healing
pmc-13117710.creator: Petya Peneva, Vesela Kokova, Elisaveta Apostolova, Plamen Simeonov, Nikolay Zahariev, Yana Gvozdeva, Dimitar Penkov, Rayna Hadjikinova, Ilia Bivolarski, Maria Koleva, Plamen Katsarov
pmc-13117710.description: The development of effective topical drug delivery systems remains a key challenge in wound management, particularly for bioactive compounds with limited skin permeability. In this study, a nanostructured bigel system incorporating sodium humate-loaded ultra-deformable vesicles (UDVs) was developed and evaluated for wound healing applications.

pmc-13285837.title: Direct oral anticoagulants in portal vein thrombosis in patients with cirrhosis: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13285837.creator: Andrea Boccatonda, Alice Brighenti, Chiara Simion, Angela Napolitano, Carla Serra, Paolo Simioni, Elena Campello
pmc-13285837.description: The optimal anticoagulant strategy for portal vein thrombosis (PVT) in patients with cirrhosis remains uncertain, particularly regarding the role of direct oral anticoagulants (DOACs) compared with vitamin K antagonists (VKAs), low-molecular-weight heparin, or no anticoagulation. We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis of studies evaluating DOAC therapy in patients with cirrhosis with PVT.
